visual_identity.core_identity: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw communicates overwhelming subterranean scale.
visual_identity.silhouette: Huge cylindrical segmented body emerging through earth or rock, front dominated by a round open maw.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate skull; front is a circular muscular mouth ringed with inward-pointing teeth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and a long continuation beyond the visible composition.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple segmented plates or folds; minimal fine texture.

accuracy_checks: gargantuan scale is obvious from relative scale cues

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
